o.text: Ultimately from Arabic مَاوِيّ (māwiyy, “watery”). The “gay” sense is a semantic loan from Russian голубо́й (golubój, “light blue; gay”).

o.text: Internationalism; ultimately from French bar, from Ancient Greek βάρος (báros).
A derivation from Proto-Turkic *güb- (“to be proud; to hope”) + -an. Compare Turkish güvenmek.
Likely a calque of Russian ни́же по́яса (níže pójasa). Literally, 'below the belt'.
From Arabic تَبَعَة (tabaʕa), plural of تَابِع (tābiʕ).
